questions.question: How is Boogie Woogie activated?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Boogie Woogie activates when the user claps their hands together.

questions.question: What does Boogie Woogie do?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: The technique switches the positions of the user and anything they desire that has above a certain amount of cursed energy.

questions.question: Can Boogie Woogie swap targets without moving the user?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: The user can also switch things or people not including themselves (i.e. The user can swap their partner with their adversary's position), and clap their hands with another person's to activate the technique.

questions.question: How did Todo first use Boogie Woogie at the Spirit Bash Race?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Todo first used Boogie Woogie to create confusion on the battlefield of the Spirit Bash Race. He stopped his teammates from attacking Yuji by moving them out of their advantageous positions to nullify their ambush. It was instantaneous and caught everyone off guard including Yuji. The Kyoto Team ended up aiming their attacks at one another until Todo appeared to intimidate them.(Chapter 35, Episode 15)

questions.question: Why does Boogie Woogie work so well for Aoi Todo?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Boogie Woogie is a simple but effective technique that can be a great weapon when wielded by a clever sorcerer like Todo.(Chapter 50, Episode 20) This is mostly due to his eccentric creativity and high intellect.

questions.question: How did Boogie Woogie throw off Hanami's judgment of Todo and Yuji?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Hanami judged Todo and Yuji's strength to be well below their own, but Boogie Woogie completely threw off their judgment, allowing Todo and Yuji to land several vital blows that crippled the special grade.(Chapter 50, Episode 20)

questions.question: What did Todo do when he first used Boogie Woogie against Hanami?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: He first used it to switch places with Hanami, forcing the cursed spirit to impale themself on their own spiked roots.(Chapter 50, Episode 20)

questions.question: What did Todo do besides activating Boogie Woogie during the fight with Hanami?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: He also clapped without actually activating the effect, throwing off any anticipatory strategy Hanami built up while trying to defend.(Chapter 50, Episode 20)

questions.question: How did Todo use Boogie Woogie to protect Yuji from one of Hanami's cursed buds?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: By switching Yuji with Hanami, Aoi was able to keep Yuji from being hit by one of Hanami's cursed bud.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)

questions.question: What did Todo reveal about Boogie Woogie's range near the end of the fight with Hanami?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: He switched out Yuji for the special grade cursed tool; Playful Cloud and dealt a devastating blow that crushed Hanami's weak points and pushed the cursed spirit to the edge of defeat.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)

questions.question: How did Todo use Boogie Woogie to save Yuji from Mahito in Shibuya?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: In Shibuya, Todo used Boogie Woogie to save Yuji from Mahito at the last moment. Just before Mahito killed Todo's defeated best friend, the grade 1 sorcerer swapped places with the cursed spirit.

questions.question: What did Mahito admit about Boogie Woogie after taking it several times?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Having already been on the receiving end of Boogie Woogie several times at the beginning of the fight, Mahito admitted it was extremely disorienting despite knowing how it works.(Chapter 127, Episode 44)

questions.question: How did Todo use a transfigured human to counterattack Mahito?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Mahito attempted to use another transfigured human to initiate his counterattack, only for Todo to switch spots with it. This completely took Mahito by surprise, who didn't expect Todo to detect the cursed energy from a delayed transfiguration on a non-living target. With the curse vulnerable, Todo capitalized by unlocking the power Black Flash for the first time, striking Mahito from behind with a powerful kick.(Chapter 128, Episode 44)

questions.question: How did Todo put down the Polymorphic Soul Isomer?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: After being hit clean through a building by the Polymorphic Soul Isomer, Todo threw a coat hanger infused with his cursed energy. Once the hanger got behind the transfigured human's head, Todo switched places with it and delivered a powerful strike that put down the Polymorphic Soul Isomer.(Chapter 129, Episode 45)

questions.question: How did Todo activate Boogie Woogie one last time despite his severed hand?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: After surviving Mahito's Black Flash, Todo narrowly escaped death by slapping his hand onto Mahito's to initiate a clap and activate Boogie Woogie one last time. This immediately swapped Todo's place with Yuji, allowing Yuji to once again hit Mahito with a Black Flash.(Chapter 130, Episode 45)

questions.question: How did Yuji deliver the fight-ending blow to Mahito?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Yuji took advantage of the false activation of Boogie Woogie and landed a fight-ending Black Flash that defeated Mahito once and for all.(Chapter 132, Episode 45)

questions.question: How did Todo modify the activation of Boogie Woogie after losing his hand?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: In his and Yuji's battle against Sukuna, Todo unveiled that he had replaced his missing hand with a vibraslap. The modification changed the activation trigger of his Boogie Woogie technique from a handclap to the striking of a vibraslap, which now allows for 50 position swaps per second, effectively "revising" his Boogie Woogie.(Chapter 260)

questions.question: What binding vow did Todo take to broaden Boogie Woogie?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Furthermore, Todo has taken a binding vow that permits him to exchange multiple targets and broaden the reach of his technique by imposing a restriction that limits the frequency of swaps. With Yuta Okkotsu's help, he has honed this ability.(Chapter 260)

questions.question: What is the origin of the name Boogie-woogie?
questions.subject: Boogie Woogie

answer.item: Boogie-woogie is the name of a genre of piano-based music that originated from African-American communities in the 1870s and was popularized in the late 1970s.
